title: Home Credit makes the latest iPhone 18 Pro and 18 Pro Max more accessible with double-zero and trade-in offers
summary: The latest iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone 18 Pro Max has officially arrived in the Philippines, and Home Credit Philippines (HCPH) is giving Filipinos a more flexible and easier way to make their next…

blocks.text: The latest iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone 18 Pro Max has officially arrived in the Philippines, and Home Credit Philippines (HCPH) is giving Filipinos a more flexible and easier way to make their next device upgrade through its Double-Zero and the newly introduced trade-In offer that lets customers maximize the value of their current smartphone.

Recognizing the growing role smartphones play in how people stay connected and manage their daily lives, Home Credit continues to provide more accessible and flexible ways for consumers to purchase flagship devices without placing unnecessary strain on their budgets.
Starting today, eligible customers can secure the new iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone 18 Pro Max for up to ₱ 137 per day.

With Home Credit’s Double-Zero offer, customers can enjoy 0% interest and zero down payment, depending on customer eligibility on iPhone 18 Pro and Phone 18 Pro Max purchases at participating authorized Apple stores nationwide. Customers can enjoy flexible installment terms of up to 24 months, making it easier to spread the cost of ownership over time.

Home Credit is introducing its new trade-In offer, allowing eligible customers to get up to ₱50,000 in trade-in value for their current iPhone. The approved value can be applied toward the down payment of a new iPhone purchased through Home Credit. On top of the trade-in value, eligible customers can enjoy additional discounts of up to P12,000, making their next iPhone upgrade even more accessible. Customers can check their installment shopping offer eligibility through the Home Credit app and visit participating authorized Apple retailers to avail of the offer. Terms and conditions apply.

“At Home Credit, we believe that getting closer to the things you want should feel simpler and more affordable. With our Double-Zero offer and new Trade-in deals, customers can now enjoy a simpler and more affordable upgrade experience,” said Puneet Suneja, Chief Sales Officer of Home Credit Philippines.

Available through Home Credit’s extensive nationwide partner network, across key metropolitan cities and growth provinces across Luzon, Visayas and Mindanao, the iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone 18 Pro Max offers are designed to help customers plan their purchases with greater confidence. Customers interested in availing the Double-Zero and Trade-in offers may visit Apple partner stores nationwide including Abenson, Aerophone, Beyond the Box, Cellboy, Digimap, Digital Walker, GameXtreme, In-box, Power Mac Center, Silicon Valley, The Loop, and Wiltelcom, or shop at over 5,000 Apple resellers offering Home Credit financing.

Starting October 16 at 8 P.M., customers may also pre-order the iPhone Duo through Home Credit for as low as ₱ 227 per day for up to 24 months calculated based on 0% interest and zero down payment, making it even easier to secure Apple’s latest innovation with flexible and manageable payment options. The addition of the iPhone Duo to Home Credit’s financing portfolio further reinforces the company’s commitment to providing Filipinos with more ways to access premium devices through payment solutions that fit their budget and financial priorities.
Home Credit Philippines is a financing company duly licensed and supervised by the Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) and the Bangko Sentral ng Pilipinas (BSP).
